name: build-acceptance-polarity
description: The tech spec states the opposite of what the brief promises — the phase promises recovery, the spec says a signed-out device stays locked and recovery is not wired. Build's 0c.3 polarity gate must catch that at pre-flight: no ledger, no code, both statements quoted, routed to `mano spec`. Building it anyway, or inverting the promise to match the spec, is the incident this rule exists for.
